capabilities: Send selected text or the current line to a configured LLM provider and insert the response
Expand wikilinks in the input with the full content of linked notes before sending
Use Markdown template files as system prompts with ai-* frontmatter overrides
Append vault note names to the prompt so the LLM can emit resolvable wikilinks
Manage multiple named LLM connections with per-provider credentials and models
extras: Desktop-only (the CLI provider uses Node child_process) and requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later. README states no telemetry and that API keys are stored locally in the plugin data store; further documentation lives in a documentation/ folder referenced but not included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run a language model on selected text and insert the answer in place of or after the selection.

relations.evidence: Claude via OpenAI-compatible proxies (OpenRouter, Together, internal gateways)

requires.name: Copilot, Claude, Claude proxy, or Gemini API key
Local CLI tool such as claude, llm, or gemini on PATH

summary: AI query plugin that sends selected text to Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or a local CLI and inserts the LLM response into the current note.
